lastComments.body:
Env var expansion will help a lot with stuff like this:

```
[shell_environment_policy]
set = { GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = "${HOME}/.config/git/agent.config" } # Use agent git config
```

`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` needs to be absolute, so `~/` won't work.

I have this in my dotfiles that automatically pulled in Dev Containers, so having project-specific config is not an option.
